IF D23581100-14, SEE D23581300-14: THE FOLLOWING GEAR & A/C CONFIGURATIONS ARE POSSIBLE: A = POST MOD 43435 & PRE MOD 56814 & 58794 (OVSTEER WARNING SYSTEM ACTIVE). B = SBS 32-3234/32-4276 EMBODIED ON NLG (OVSTEER WARNING SYSTEM DE-ACTIVATED). C = MOD 58794 EMBODIED ON NLG & PRE MOD 201082 (OVSTEER WARNING SYSTEM REMOVED IN PRODUCTION) OR PRE MOD 43435. THE OPTIONS FOR REPLACEMENT OF GEAR DURING AOG SITUATIONS & THE ACTIONS RQRD TO AVOID CONFIG ISSUES ARE: A TO B; 2-WAY ICY ONLY WHEN SB 32-3234 OR 32-4276 IS EMBODIED ON THE A/C & PROVIDED THAT NLG LEG & ELEC BOX ARE REPLACED TOGETHER. B TO A; 2-WAY ICY ONLY WHEN SB 32-3234 OR 32-4276 IS EMBODIED ON THE REPLACEMENT GEAR & PROVIDED THAT NLG LEG & ELEC BOX ARE REPLACED TOGETHER. B TO B; NONE. NOTE: REMAINING CONFIGS (A TO A, A TO C, B TO C, C TO A, C TO B & C TO C) ARE COVERED IN MP-H16032. IT MUST BE NOTED THAT ALTHOUGH THE DEACTIVATION OF THE OVERSTEER WARNING SYSTEM DOES NOT INVOLVE THE MOD OR REMOVAL OF ANY PART INCLUDED IN THE ALS PART 1, NEW RNLG PNRS ARE RQRD MEANING THAT THE ALS PART 1 IS AFFECTED. REINFORCED NLG D23581300 & WBS REINFORCED NLG D23581350. THERE ARE NO CHANGES TO EITHER THE FATIGUE LIVES OR PNRS OF ANY PSE PARTS LISTED IN ALS PART 1. TWO RELAYS (5GH & 7GH) WILL BE DISCONNECTED TO DISABLE THE 8GH BOX. A TECHNICAL REPORT DESCRIBING THE PRINCIPLE BEHIND THE DEACTIVATION IS AVAILABLE (SCF/SYS/P/09/58240). FOR TRACEABILITY OF THE MOD HISTORY FOR EACH GEAR, THE DASH NUMBER FOR THE MODIFIED GEARS WILL DEPEND UPON WHICH OF THE PRECEDING MODS HAVE BEEN EMBODIED. THIS INFO HAS BEEN PROVIDED IN MD-SA FAM 139 ISSUE 4. THE EMBODIMENT OF FAM 139 CHANGES THE NLG LEG & MAIN FITTING SHOCK ABSORB P/N RESPECTIVELY UNDER THE FOLLOWING RULE: D235811X0-YYY BECOMES D235813X0-YYY D235821X0-YYY BECOMES D235823X0-YYY WHERE X = 0 OR 5, DEPENDING UPON THE TYPE OF GEAR. YYY IS DEPENDENT UPON THE MODS EMBODIED PRIOR TO THIS MOD.; docs: AD 2013-0179, AD 2014-23-08, AD CAD2010-MULT-06R1
